about_the_game:
Golf With Your Friends 2 is allowing us to take Golfing to the next level. Reintroducing beloved features from the first game with all new updates to improve the core experience, while delivering a range of brand-new features that putts a whole new spin on your golfing game sessions.

Level Editor 2.0

Design, build, and play like never before with our brand-new mini golf level editor! Inspired by our old Golf With Your Friends level editor, level editor 2.0 takes course creation to the next level with more powerful tools, an intuitive interface, and limitless customization. Whether you're a casual player looking to design a fun challenge for friends or a dedicated creator crafting intricate, mind-bending holes, our system makes it easier than ever. Drag, drop, and fine-tune every element with precision custom terrain, dynamic obstacles, and interactive features ensure your vision comes to life exactly as you imagined.

We can’t bring this to life without you, expect a demo for the community before launch!

Reward System

In our previous game, we noticed that not everyone knew how to unlock or equip customization items for their golf ball. That’s why we’ve introduced a brand-new, intuitive rewards system that clearly shows how to earn the cosmetics you want. Every item in this system is completely free to unlock no purchases, just play and customize your way!

Cosmetic Types

We’re bringing back all your favourite cosmetic types, but what’s a new game without something fresh? Introducing Hole Explosions a brand-new way to celebrate every shot! Sink the ball and watch as dazzling effects burst from the hole, making every victory feel even more rewarding. From fiery blasts to playful confetti showers, customize your perfect finishing touch and make your mark on the course like never before!

Courses

Let’s be real the best part of Golf With Your Friends is the courses and Gingy. We’re bringing you six brand-new ones to master! But we’re not just stopping at fresh holes to play we’re packing each course with its own unique gameplay mechanic to shake things up. Whether you're skating around the beaches, defying gravity, or navigating twists and turns, each course offers a fresh challenge and a whole new way to play. Get ready for an adventure where no two courses feel the same!

Golf With Your Friends 2 will feature:

6 Courses

Cross- Platform Online Multiplayer

Level Editor – Cross- Platform

New Course mechanics

Weather Hazards

New ways to customise your balls

Level Up and Unlock Rewards!
